# netbox_vlan (Resource)

A NetBox VLAN (ipam.vlan).

From the [official documentation](https://netboxlabs.com/docs/netbox/models/ipam/vlan/):

> A Virtual LAN (VLAN) represents an isolated layer two domain, identified by a name and a numeric ID (1-4094) as defined in [IEEE 802.1Q](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/IEEE_802.1Q). VLANs are arranged into [VLAN groups](https://netboxlabs.com/docs/netbox/models/ipam/vlangroup/) to define scope and to enforce uniqueness.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netbox_site" "test" {
  name = "test-site"
}

resource "netbox_tenant" "test" {
  name = "test-tenant"
}

resource "netbox_ipam_role" "test" {
  name = "test-ipam-role"
}

resource "netbox_vlan_group" "test" {
  name = "test-vlan-group"
  vid_ranges = [
    { start = 1, end = 4094 },
  ]
}

resource "netbox_vlan" "test" {
  name        = "test-vlan"
  vid         = 100
  status      = "active"
  description = "test-description"
  tenant_id   = netbox_tenant.test.id
  site_id     = netbox_site.test.id
  group_id    = netbox_vlan_group.test.id
  role_id     = netbox_ipam_role.test.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `vid` (Number) VLAN id (1-4094).

### Optional

- `comments` (String)
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values by field name. Every value is a string; NetBox coerces numbers and booleans. A key removed from the map is cleared in NetBox (set {} to clear all).
- `description` (String)
- `group_id` (Number) Id of the VLAN group.
- `owner_id` (Number) Id of the owner the object is assigned to.
- `qinq_role` (String) Q-in-Q role: a service VLAN (svlan) carrying customer VLANs, or a customer VLAN (cvlan) inside one. One of: svlan, cvlan.
- `qinq_svlan_id` (Number) Id of the service VLAN this customer VLAN is carried in (qinq_role cvlan).
- `role_id` (Number) Id of the role.
- `site_id` (Number) Id of the site.
- `status` (String) Operational status. One of: active, reserved, deprecated.
- `tags` (Set of String) Slugs of the tags assigned to the object (the provider's default_tags are added on top, see tags_all).
- `tenant_id` (Number) Id of the tenant.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String)
- `id` (Number) NetBox id.
- `last_updated` (String)
- `prefix_count` (Number) Number of prefixes on the VLAN.
- `tags_all` (Set of String) Slugs of all tags on the object, including the provider's default_tags.
- `url` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = netbox_vlan.test
  id = "123"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import netbox_vlan.test 123
```
